title: External Challenge Receipt Binding and Nonce Replay Ledger Screening
requirements: Receipt bytes and ledger bytes compared to separately claimed SHA-256 digests
Receipt binds challenge ID, enrollment ID, custodian ID, nonce, holder key fingerprint and capture digest
Hash-chain consumption records detect repeated nonces, missing consumption, modified chain heads and changed previous links
Source, holder and issuer declared roots must not repeat
Out-of-band signature/key/controller authentication explicitly NOT_PERFORMED: a hash is not signature verification
Caller-provided ledger does not prove independent remote consumption or temporal freshness
All real external receipts/nonce ledgers absent from repository fixture; CI emits rejection evidence without simulated PASS
